The oldest brother in **7th Heaven** was **Matt Camden**, played by **Barry Watson**.

Matt Camden was the firstborn son of Eric and Annie Camden. His siblings included Mary (older sister), Lucy (older sister), Simon (younger brother), Ruthie (younger sister), and the twin brothers Sam and David (younger brothers).

Barry Watson played Matt Camden throughout the series and has continued acting in shows like *Masters of Sex*, *Hart of Dixie*, and *Gossip Girl* after *7th Heaven* ended.
